title: Identify a USA job-name lookup for the selected actor
changes: Record selected-actor arguments and a job-name lookup for the existing USA route, and retain the conflicting source labels and character quarantine.
validation: A cheat-free isolated USA Wine/Xvfb run followed the existing ability-screen input route and captured six interpreter breakpoint calls for the first roster member. Each used primary 50 and alternate 02; property zero returned decimal index 29. Checked field bytes and protected inputs stayed unchanged, the window closed normally and Wine drained. Evidence: target/validation/units/dbg20-usa-job-call-registers-uienjad6/.

A separate protected static check decoded the original caller branch, verified its pointer-table indexing after the retained return value, and resolved that USA string to Soldier. It authenticated the ROM and preserved both the ROM and the prior breakpoint result. Evidence: target/validation/units/dbg20-usa-job-name-caller-_8hlaicc/.

Focused consultant `/root/sol_domain_diagnosis` was requested as gpt-6.1-sol with xhigh. It identified the unresolved source-label discrepancy, warned that executable domains would lift quarantine, and proposed register capture; effective model and effort were not independently exposed.
limitations: One actor, property and checkpoint were correlated; this does not validate all job/race combinations, other properties, the earlier job-screen title, learned abilities, battle behavior or physical devices. The local XP table labels Soldier 01 and 02 as a dash; no source was silently corrected. Original CH-0236 remains excluded and original character examples remain reference-only.
